extracted.intended_audience: aspiring authors seeking self-publishing services / authors evaluating Archway Publishing
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and claims intended to help authors evaluate Archway Publishing's self-publishing services (design, editorial, formatting, marketing) and the terms for requesting a free publishing guide. Focus is on features, service scope, and marketing-consent terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence in design
rubrics_metrics.description: Archway Publishing provides the highest quality in design, formatting, editorial and marketing services; each book design specialist on Archway’s team follows design guidelines provided by Simon & Schuster.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes professional, publisher-level design standards (Simon & Schuster guidelines) as a selling point; implies expectation of high production values for book interiors and covers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailored publishing packages
rubrics_metrics.description: Tailored publishing packages with specialty options for fiction, nonfiction, business and children’s books so authors can choose a publishing path designed to reach and engage their book’s intended audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection of package should align with a book's genre and target audience; implies packages vary in services to meet different market/genre needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unique services to aid discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: Archway Publishing will offer several unique services designed to help you and your book get discovered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promises additional, distinct marketing/discovery resources beyond standard services; suggests emphasis on discoverability as a criterion when choosing a provider.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specialized approach with expert support and creative control
rubrics_metrics.description: With unique resources to support books of all kinds, Archway Publishing offers a specialized approach with expert self-publishing services provided by Author Solutions. Archway was created for authors ... looking for expert advice and unique services combined with creative control.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions the service as combining professional guidance (expert advice) with retention of author creative control; authors evaluating services should weigh level of editorial/marketing expertise against how much control they keep.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free publishing guide call-to-action
rubrics_metrics.description: Request your free publishing guide today to begin your own publishing journey. Call 844-669-3957 or click 'Claim My Free Guide'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The free guide is the entry point for engagement; authors should expect outreach after requesting the guide (see consent terms). Contact phone number is provided for immediate inquiry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marketing contact consent and messaging terms
rubrics_metrics.description: By clicking 'Claim My Free Guide', you are providing your electronic signature, voluntarily authorizing Archway Publishing and its affiliates to contact you using a manual or automated telephone dialing system, including pre-recorded or artificially-generated voices or messages, and to send you advertisement or telemarketing messages by email or text/SMS/MMS to the address and phone number you have provided above.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consumer-protection / consent details: you are not required to agree to this in order to buy products or services from Archway; you must certify that you are over 18; you'll get up to ten (10) messages per month; standard message and data rates may apply. A link to the Privacy Policy is provided for more details.
